versions.changelog:
llmfit-2 v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for llmfit
- Enables querying local hardware (GPU/CPU/RAM) to find compatible open-weight LLM models via CLI
- Returns ranked model list with estimated speed and VRAM requirements
- Supports filters (context length, quantization, model family) and server mode for automation
- Designed for integration in agent workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and local model selection
